name: crossref-affiliations-ror-benchmark
description: A dataset for mapping free-text affiliation strings (from Crossref metadata) to canonical ROR (Research Organization Registry) identifiers. It measures affiliation-to-organization linking/normalization performance, useful for evaluating entity linking and organization disambiguation systems on scholarly metadata. Typical inputs are affiliation strings; outputs are correct ROR identifiers.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (whether the predicted ROR ID exactly matches the gold ROR ID)
reputation: Niche but practical dataset used by bibliographic and metadata-processing communities for affiliation normalization; modest community adoption.
